content: ESP32-S3 SD over SPI in Arduino: create SPIClass instance (HSPI/FSPI), call spi.begin(SCK,MISO,MOSI,CS) with custom pins, then SD.begin(CS, spi) passing the instance - SD library otherwise ignores custom pins (arduino-esp32 issue 8457). SD+SD_MMC are built into arduino-esp32 core, no PlatformIO lib_deps needed. SD.begin returns false on failure - handle gracefully.
